summary: Enhance your expertise in banking with our comprehensive training on licensing and regulatory approvals. Stay compliant and informed in a dynamic industry.
lede: Securing authorization for banking activities involves showing that an institution meets applicable requirements and is prepared to operate. For compliance, legal, risk, finance and operations professionals supporting applications, this course covers mapping requirements, organizing submission evidence, and assessing governance, capital and controls.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who manage or support licensing, approvals, compliance readiness, and regulator engagement across financial institutions.
modules: Licensing and Approvals: The Big Picture
Licensing Strategy and Business Model Alignment
Governance, Board Readiness, and Fit-and-Proper Standards
Capital, Financial Projections, and Prudential Requirements
Risk Management and Internal Controls for Approvals
Consumer Protection, Conduct Risk, and Product Approvals
Managing the Regulator Relationship and Approval Process
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial services, regulatory frameworks, and be involved in licensing or compliance roles within their organizations.
